text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaaa~h! Top Road-san, show us your 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan! You're an amazing girl! A girl 
of pure grit! You can definitely, 
definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see your reign again! Opera O! Go 
get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Cafe! Overtake the older generation all at 
once! For Tachyon's sake too... you guys 
are the new generation!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
—With things turning out like this... I 
wonder how Air Shakur's going to factor 
into all this.

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
She's basically the top of that generation 
now... Well, she's practically the only 
one left, really. Though Agudigi's a bit 
of an exception.

text_block_list.name: Spectator G
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur-san... you can definitely win. 
You're the absolute best...—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah, so this is the "Arima Kinen"...! It's 
just like a festival.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I hear both the running Umamusume and the 
spectators put a tremendous amount of 
passion into it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fine, you possess extraordinary talent... 
You may have opportunities to race 
starting next year.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If I could run amidst such a lively 
atmosphere... I'm sure it would become a 
truly wonderful memory."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I just hope it stays as merely a 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I'll just watch Shakur. So that none of 
her feelings slip through the cracks."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well now. I'm looking forward to 
this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Shut up. Can they seriously hear us all 
the way out here?
choice_data_list: Why don't you try asking them?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why? It's just gonna be a bunch of lame 
voices anyway.
choice_data_list: That's what I need to find out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur gently closed her eyes. She 
listened closely, focusing on the voices 
around her—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(The noise is... unraveling. Expectations, 
doubts, enthusiasm, hostility...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... What the hell? Is this all it 
amounted to?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I couldn't give a damn about any of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ain't even worth shutting out. None of it 
gets under my skin anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur had a refreshed look on her 
face. Something inside her must have 
finally been settled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By facing reality like that, she managed 
to make it this far.
choice_data_list: (I'll see them off quietly for now.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "You got something to say, don'tcha?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and speak. I'll at least hear you 
out.
choice_data_list:
...Go and see through what you really want 
to do.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No, you're wrong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's what I ought to do. What is it that 
*you* want?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What do you want from me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If mere 'feelings' could change anything, 
things would've flipped around ages ago!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Everything you've done was completely in 
vain. So just obediently accept your fate, 
they say."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In a situation greater than ever 
before—one that leaves no room for 
doubt... I'll engrave myself into the 
thickest skull out there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What I wish for Air Shakur—
choice_data_list: Go out there and prove it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut up, idiot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Naturally.
